newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lam Soon in talks on sale of MC Packaging.
newsitem.headline: Lam Soon in talks on sale of MC Packaging.

text.p: Lam Soon (Hong Kong) Ltd said on Wednesday that it is in talks with two overseas-based companies regarding the sale of its stake in subsidiary M.C. Packaging (Hong Kong) Ltd.
The company also said in an announcement published on Wednesday it is not in talks with Coca-Cola.

Lam Soon said it has been approached by the Hong Kong subsidiary of a U.S. company and by a private Singaporean investment company, both of which are interested in acquiring Lam Soon's 51.2 percent stake in M.C. Packaging.
The announcement said the company is in active talks with both companies and expects to make a final decision in relation to the disposal within the next few days.
Either company acquiring Lam Soon's stake would be required to make a general offer for M.C. Packaging.

Lam Soon holds the bulk of its M.C. Packaging shares through its majority stake in holding company Fung Shun, and Ng Fung Hung (Holdings) Ltd has a right of per-emption of any transfer of Lam Soon's stake in Fung Shun, the announcement noted.
Ng Fung Hung (Holdings) is the controlling shareholder of listed Ng Fung Hong Ltd, which is engaged in live and frozen foodstuffs distribution.
Lam Soon could not comment on suggestions that Ng Fung Hong was also considering a sale of its interest in M.C. Packaging, the notice said.
The announcement did not say how many shares in M.C. Packaging that Ng Fung Hong controlled.
Trading in the shares of Lam Soon and M.C. Packaging resumed on Wednesday, after being suspending on Monday and Tuesday.
Lam Soon was untraded at HK$1.35 and M.C. Packaging was traded but unchanged at HK$2.65 in early morning.
